items.title: Multiple Hacking Groups Exploit OpenClaw Instances to Steal API key and Deploy Malware
items.description: A widespread exploitation of OpenClaw, formerly known as MoltBot and ClawdBot, by multiple hacking groups to deploy malicious payloads. OpenClaw, an open-source autonomous AI framework developed by Peter Steinberger, now at OpenAI, has become a high-severity target following its viral adoption in late January 2026.
